name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, stock levels, carts, orders, and order line items.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Validates caller tokens issued by Thunder and resolves the caller's role (Shopper vs Store Admin) for protected endpoints.

dependencies.name: payment-provider
dependencies.description: Stripe's REST API for tokenized card charges at checkout — creates a PaymentIntent/charge from the client-side-tokenized card and reports success/decline.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create and capture charges server-side.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: SendGrid's Mail Send v3 REST API for order confirmation and fulfillment status emails to shoppers.

config.description: SendGrid API key used to authenticate mail-send requests.
The verified sender address order emails are sent from.

description: The backend for the ceramics store: product catalog with stock tracking, cart, checkout (card payment + flat-rate shipping), order history, and admin catalog/order management. Sits behind the gateway on the intranet exposure; the webapp is the only caller. Does not issue tokens (Thunder does) and does not talk to shipping carriers.
